feeds.title: Downright Joy
feeds.description: Discovering joy in unexpected places - a journey into parenthood and Down's Syndrome

feeds.title: Global Down Syndrome Foundation Blog
feeds.description: Dedicated to significantly improving the lives of people with Down Syndrome through research, medical care, education and advocacy.

feeds.title: CDSS Blog
feeds.description: The Canadian Down Syndrome Society (CDSS) is a non-profit organization promoting awareness, advocacy and support for those with Down syndrome in Canada.

feeds.title: Mardra Sikora » Grown Ups & Downs
feeds.description: I didn't know how to raise a child with Down syndrome...We've learned many lessons that have been more special than the needs.

feeds.title: Down Syndrome Association of Wisconsin Blog
feeds.description: The mission of the Down Syndrome Association of Wisconsin is to provide support to Wisconsin families and individuals with Down syndrome through awareness, education, information, programs, services, and the exchange of ideas and experiences.

feeds.title: TheSassySouthernGal
feeds.description: I am The Sassy Southern Gal living in the Midwest. My daughter Rachel has Down syndrome, and I mostly blog about our adventures, the highs, and lows of this journey. Come along and you'll soon see why I am TheSassySouthernGal!

feeds.title: monicajakubisin
feeds.description: This blog is created to give others encouragement about living with Down syndrome. Our daughter has Down syndrome and is very happy to be alive. In fact, our family has a wonderful life and Monica brings so much joy to us. I hope that this blog will help families have hope and courage when they are surprised by a child with Down syndrome.

feeds.title: DSDN
feeds.description: The mission of Down Syndrome Diagnosis Network (DSDN) is to connect, support and provide accurate information to families with a Down syndrome diagnosis.

feeds.title: Kelle Hampton » Down Syndrome
feeds.description: Enjoying the Small Things is the award-winning blog where author Kelle Hampton weaves together photography and also about having a child with Down Syndrome.

feeds.title: Down Syndrome Prenatal Testing
feeds.description: Down syndrome prenatal testing and discussion by bioethicist Mark Leach. Blog discusses NIPT, prenatal testing and its ethics, living with Down syndrome, and bioethics.

feeds.title: Downs Side Up
feeds.description: Award-winning Down's syndrome blog.Gently changing perceptions of Down's Syndrome from within hearts. Down's Syndrome Support. Natty is a model with Down's Syndrome.Gently Change Perceptions of Down's Syndrome from Within Hearts:Inspire, Love, Change, Campaign, Educate, Lead, Support.

feeds.title: Confessions of the Chromosomally Enhanced
feeds.description: A sister documents the sibling relationship with her adult sister with Down syndrome, who inspired the adoption of her daughter with Down syndrome. It's an honest perspective on adults with Down syndrome, as well as the developmental journey of a children with Down sydnrome. Follow these two 'Divas of Down syndrome' as they grow, learn, teach, and inspire.

feeds.title: Inclusion Evolution
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Courtney former journalist and teacher, current advocate, proud military wife, and domestic engineer to 3 kids and one who happens to rock an extra chromosome. Welcome to my virtual soapbox for the empowerment of individuals with disabilities. The latest generation of kids with Down syndrome will demand more, and they deserve more! This blog is an experiment and exploration in how they can achieve more.

feeds.title: Cedar's Story
feeds.description: Cedar has Down Syndrome and for all my education and background (I was a social worker for 15 years) I knew very, very little about Down Syndrome. Immediately a passion was born to help spread information, awareness, and help to others who, like me, are gifted a child with Down Syndrome. So, pull up a chair, read along, and know that you are not alone.

feeds.title: Coraline & Us Blog
feeds.description: Liz Arriens shares her journey of growth. After the birth of her daughter Coraline in 2017, Liz and her husband Kevin discovered unexpectedly within hours that Coraline has Down's Syndrome and two holes in the heart. Through this blog, Liz shares the positive life wisdom she has gained through her daughter.

feeds.title: Girl in a Party Hat
feeds.description: Having a kid with down syndrome is the most interesting thing that ever happened to me authored by Amy Silverman. Also an author of 'My Heart Can't Even Believe It: A Story of Science, Love, and Down Syndrome' Book.

feeds.title: Bringing the Sunshine -'Life doesn't have to be perfect to be wonderful.'
feeds.description: I'm an ordinary mom living an extraordinary life with a daughter with cerebral palsy, a son with Down syndrome, an adventurous husband, a once-wild Westie, a rescued Schnoodle, a camera, and a worn out pair of running shoes.

feeds.title: I am River Blog
feeds.description: Love, Laughter and Life. A Little Boy and his Family's Journey with Down Syndrome

feeds.title: Love for Colin
feeds.description: Colin was born in April of '09 with an extra chromosome that we weren't expecting. We have learned that the one thing we weren't expecting is the one thing we love the most... I love keeping up this blog as a way to share our experiences with others!

feeds.title: Big Blueberry Eyes
feeds.description: A blog about raising two kids, and advocating acceptance and inclusion for all people with Down syndrome.

feeds.title: Evie the Extraordinary and Her Mommy
feeds.description: The author of this blog is a mother who describes journey of her daughter Evie who has Down Syndrome.

feeds.title: The Princess and The Tornado
feeds.description: We adopted Max on May 1, 2009. He was a month old and was born with Down syndrome, as well as a complete AV canal defect {4 holes in his heart}, which required open heart surgery at 5 months old.

feeds.title: The Chronicles of Ellie Bellie Bear
feeds.description: A stay-at-home mom and Beachbody fitness coach blogs about her a daughter with Down syndrome, ADHD and sensory processing disorder.

feeds.title: awesomeaudreyemily
feeds.description: This blog is the story of an elf with Down's Syndrome and her family.

feeds.title: Heidi's Blog
feeds.description: Journey of Heidi who have Down Syndrome.

feeds.title: Rescuing Victoria
feeds.description: This little lady is the reason we were led to adopt Victoria. When she came into this world with an extra chromosome, she also brought with her 'some great big plans'. She opened our hearts to a world we were not really aware of and boy is our life better for it. This adoption journey is just an extension of her miraculous life. She has made this all possible for her soon to be big sister.

feeds.title: Live Life Laksh Size
feeds.description: Blog about down syndrome, birth diagnosis, and Hirschsprung's disease.

feeds.title: three with a twist
feeds.description: Three with a twist blog is about family life with Down Syndrome.

feeds.title: Down Syndrome with a Slice of Autism
feeds.description: Just another WordPress.com site, Nick is 23 years old and has Down syndrome and autism. This is his world, the rest of us are just trying to keep up!

feeds.title: Chasing Hazel Foundation Blog
feeds.description: The story of Hazel - A sweet girl born with Down Syndrome (Trisomy 21). Hazel, a sweet girl with Trisomy 21. Sometimes we talk Down Syndrome. Mostly she's a kid that is trying, successfully, to manipulate her parents. Join the chase.

feeds.title: A Beautiful Life
feeds.description: I'm a proud Mum to 8 amazing children. My youngest son, Felix, has Down syndrome. I am passionate about raising awareness, and increasing acceptance of people with Down syndrome. I feel privileged to have Felix in my life and have learned, and am continuing to learn, so much from this incredible little person.

feeds.title: Garden of Eagan
feeds.description: Sharing our life parenting six kids with Down syndrome.

feeds.title: yo soy la lay
feeds.description: An author Maggie is an mother of three year old named Ellie and a new baby girl named Tessa. At her birth, she got to know that Tessa has Down syndrome. This blog is basically written about her girls by her.

feeds.title: Meeting Lauren
feeds.description: A blog about our busy family with two amazing kids, one of whom happens to have Down syndrome!

feeds.title: Simply Lambchops
feeds.description: Simply Lambchops is a Singapore family blog which includes parenting experiences to a child with T21, or more commonly known as Down Syndrome.

feeds.title: The Mighty Willow
feeds.description: An author is mother describes her son Willow journey who has Down Syndrome.

feeds.title: Down's with the kids
feeds.description: Steve Palmer's blog about his son Stanley - who has Down's Syndrome - & the extended family

feeds.title: Crouzons, Downs and Me....Love and Life
feeds.description: This is my life, living with and having children with Crouzon syndrome and Down syndrome.

feeds.title: CAMP HOMESCHOOL
feeds.description: A blog about life in a large Catholic family. Special needs homeschooling, Down syndrome, cranberry farming, recipes, homemaking tips.

feeds.title: Lindsaykids7
feeds.description: We are a family blessed with nine children. Four of our blessings were born to us, and five joined us through adoption. They have Down Syndrome and are such a blessing to us and everyone who knows them! Jamie and I have been married 20 years. We are now seeking to live together in a way that is pleasing to Jesus as our family encounters new challenges and embraces what each day brings.

feeds.title: Led By His Love
feeds.description: This blog document the one who has captured our hearts, Susan. A baby girl found in Eastern Europe. She has Down syndrome and we have committed to bringing her home where she belongs. No one should be left alone because of their designer genes. Susan deserves a life outside of an orphanage. She deserves the blessings of a family! She deserves a chance to blossom and bloom!

feeds.title: Celebrating Phoenix
feeds.description: When my first daughter was born with Down syndrome, I felt like my life was blown apart. It's been the hardest, most profound experience of my life, one which has made me examine my ideas around ability and disability. This is my life raising a child with Down syndrome (and alopecia) and identical twins. These are my thoughts on life, disability, Down syndrome, my family and me.

feeds.title: Musings of a SEND mummy
feeds.description: Scarlett has Down syndrome. My initial fears when she was born was for her quality of life, and ours I suppose, would she be ok? Be happy? Lead a 'normal' life? Would the picture I had in my mind of family still be a reality picnics in the park, roast dinners on Sunday? The Mother of a disabled child. I hope that by sharing a little of our lives I can help to change that.

feeds.title: Life with Charley - And Down Syndrome
feeds.description: A blog about Down syndrome parenting, adoption, and adults with Down syndrome.

feeds.title: Honoring Jensen
feeds.description: Down syndrome awareness and life after the loss of our son.

feeds.title: Down With Jax
feeds.description: Down With Jax Blog is about Adoption, Down syndrome, 2 moms, and our random life adventures.

feeds.title: What's New With The W Family
feeds.description: A blog about Down Syndrome, midwest living, and raising boys authored by Angie Willey.

feeds.title: In My Own Words
feeds.description: In My Own Words is a blog dedicated to interviewing people with Down syndrome and sharing their stories, reflections, and experiences.

feeds.title: Embracing Wade
feeds.description: The story of life with my son Wade who has Down Syndrome. The gorgeous , funny, little light in my world.

feeds.title: Happy Soul Project
feeds.description: Happy Soul Project is about trying to live with a grateful spirit and Happy Soul- all while balancing life as a new mum to two babies under two & one happens to have Down syndrome...Hopefully, it inspires you to look at life a wee bit differently...

feeds.title: Nossa vida com Alice Blog
feeds.description: Our life with Alice is a blog that tells the adventures of our daughter Alice, who was born with Down syndrome, and her brother Antonio 🙂

feeds.title: MAMABILITY
feeds.description: Blog about Down syndrome, working moms and spirituality.

feeds.title: Down Syndrome: A Day to Day Guide
feeds.description: In my blog, I share with you a proactive plan of action to deal with your child's root causes to prevent many of the symptoms of Trisomy 21 i.e Down Syndrome from surfacing and how to help with the symptoms that do appear until we find a way to prevent them. There's new research everyday!

feeds.title: Noah's Dad
feeds.description: This blog provides the story through their daily one minute read about their son who was born with Down syndrome. Here, they share facts, information, therapy resources, and lots more.

feeds.title: The Specials Blog
feeds.description: Multi-award winning series following the lives of Sam, Hilly, Lucy, Lewis and Megan, 5 friends with intellectual disabilities who share a house in Brighton.

feeds.title: The Diary of a Not So Ordinary Boy
feeds.description: Author Nancy describes about what it's really like to have a child with Down's Syndrome.

feeds.title: A Different View
feeds.description: Pictures, words and experiences of raising a child with Down's Syndrome.

feeds.title: That Dad Blog
feeds.description: A dads blog about life with his six kids - one of which who is blessed with Down Syndrome and the ability of flight.
